title: Mir Hassan Mir 9 Zilhaj 2026 Bibi Pak Daman Veeran Ghar Aajaway
body:
Veeran Ghar Aajaway Tera Khali Me Jhula Jhulawa
<<DIVIDER>>
Karwan Shah Chan Chiragh Rawailpindi
Karwan Shah Chan Chiragh Rawailpindi New Nohay
Mir Hassan Mir Nohay
Karwan Shah Chan Chiragh Rawailpindi Noha
Shahadat Ameer Muslim o Jori Ameer Muslim
Noha Ameer Muslim o Jori Ameer Muslim
Bibi Pak Daman Lahore
<<DIVIDER>>
Assalum-o-Alikum! Ya Ali a.s Madad
